description: Musical time: tempos and signatures, bars and beats, grid divisions and their labels, tempo-synced note values, warp markers, the metronome, and the look-ahead scheduler a transport clock runs on.

files.content:
export {
  adjacentDivision,
  barLabelInterval,
  DOTTED_FACTOR,
  divisionAt,
  divisionSeconds,
  type FixedGridDivision,
  GRID_DIVISIONS,
  type GridDivision,
  type GridIntervalOptions,
  gridInterval,
  gridLabel,
  METRONOME_RHYTHMS,
  type MetronomeRhythm,
  metronomeRhythmSeconds,
  SYNCED_DIVISIONS,
  type SyncedDivision,
  syncedSeconds,
  TRIPLET_FACTOR,
} from "./grid";
export {
  type Bar,
  barsBeatsWith,
  barsOf,
  isSignature,
  type MetronomeClick,
  metronomeClicks,
  type SignatureChange,
} from "./meter";
export {
  advance,
  anchoredCursor,
  anchorForTempoChange,
  MAX_CATCH_UP_SECONDS,
  positionAt,
  SCHEDULE_AHEAD_SECONDS,
  SCHEDULER_POLL_MS,
  type SchedulerAnchor,
  type SchedulerConfig,
  type SchedulerCursor,
  type StepBoundary,
} from "./scheduler";
export {
  type BarsBeats,
  barsBeatsAt,
  bpmToMicrosecondsPerQuarterNote,
  DEFAULT_MICROSECONDS_PER_QUARTER_NOTE,
  DEFAULT_TEMPO,
  describeBarsBeats,
  microsecondsPerQuarterNoteToBpm,
  secondsPerBar,
  secondsPerBeat,
  secondsPerQuarter,
  type Tempo,
} from "./tempo";
export {
  addWarpMarker,
  moveWarpMarker,
  removeWarpMarker,
  scaleWarp,
  unwarpedTime,
  type WarpMarker,
  warpedTime,
  warpMarkers,
  warpRate,
} from "./warp";

name: engine-time
